name: Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ Sauce (High Fructose Corn Syrup & Allium Warning)
whyItWorks: First ingredient is high-fructose corn syrup, combined with concentrated garlic powder, onion powder, acetic acid, and artificial liquid smoke. In active Crohn's/Colitis, free fructose and concentrated alliums trigger intense cramping, osmotic diarrhea, and severe heartburn.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Avoid commercial high-fructose BBQ sauces during flares. If craving barbecue, choose an allium-free low-FODMAP BBQ sauce or simple maple glaze.
watchOuts: High free fructose and concentrated allium powders provoke rapid bloating and loose watery stools.
